title: Fubar API Studio batch
description: One batches/<name>.json: a named list of calls to make together, with what should judge them. A batch is an OCCASION, which is why it sits beside the collection rather than inside it. Batches do not nest.

steps.description: In the order they will be sent. The order is the batch's own: a batch that starts with a login is stating a dependency.

endpoint.description: A path relative to collections/, e.g. orders/get-order.

case.description: One case name, or absent to run every case the endpoint has.

teardown.description: Cleanup, run after the steps whatever happened to them, and never counted towards the verdict. Where the delete goes when it is housekeeping rather than a test - stopOnFailure, the right setting for a chain, otherwise guarantees a failing step in the middle skips it. If deleting is one of the things you are testing, it belongs in steps.

environments.description: One name for most oracles, two for an environment comparison. Empty means whatever the caller chose.

overlay.description: The occasion's own rules, applied AFTER the containment chain resolves. A batch is not a level of the hierarchy - it cuts across the tree.
